newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Volume rose to 3.745 billion yuan from 1.5 billion yuan on Thursday, with the six-day contract trading the most.
Traders said the rates moved in a narrow range in dull trading with many banks decreasing their trading on the market.
"Financial institutions, especially some state-owned banks, traded less ahead of the routine checks by the central bank at the end of the year," said a local trader.

"Non-bank financial instiutions which used to be the major borrowers also increased their lending, and some of them have even turned to become net lenders on the secondary market," said another trader.
Traders expected the rates to continue to move in narrow ranges until market-moving news emerges.
